prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence for specific kinds of change is still thin, as each category has only 1 test so far.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +1.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +1.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +3.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Adoption Selection: Reorder the sign-in step to occur after pet selection and certificate creation so users build an emotional bond before creating an account. (why: Sign-in right at the start has a 76.9% conversion; moving account creation after custom pet setup improves user motivation.)
1: [home, new_flow] Desktop Pet Rendering Waiting Stage: Transform the waiting screen into a dynamic stage layout complete with background progress indicators, tip carousels, and pet animations. (why: The waiting step has high median delay (201s) and long mean time (2336s), leading to user dropoff while waiting for pet asset rendering.)
2: [choose_path, hint] Path Choice Desktop Pet Style Hint: Add clear microcopy hints to the path options detailing preset adoption versus photo-based custom pet creation. (why: Choose path takes a median of 8s with 76.2% conversion; clear hints help users quickly select the right creation route.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Backup Sign-In Assurance Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that sign-in protects against pet loss or reset. (why: Support received 8 emails complaining that pets were missing or reset after signing in.)
4: [home, wait_info] Live Pet Generation Time Estimate Banner: Display explicit live time estimates and countdown status on the waiting screen while rendering pet assets. (why: Waiting time has a 201s median and a 2336s mean; showing time estimates reduces uncertainty and dropouts.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Ready Notification Opt-In: Add a desktop notification switch to alert users when pet asset generation finishes in the background. (why: Long wait times during home generation cause users to switch windows and abandon onboarding.)
6: [adoption, layout] Two-Column Pick Friend Selection Layout: Change pick_friend screen layout to a two-column design with choice cards for faster side-by-side companion preview. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% and a 89s median completion time.)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Summary: Update the home intro text with quick desktop control instructions for summoning, moving, and hiding the pet. (why: Support logged 3 emails regarding post-onboarding confusion on pet controls and 4 emails on misbehaving features.)
